title: eCourts Phase III Progress Monitored Regularly; e-Filing 3.0 Implemented Across All District Courts in Punjab
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

eCourts Phase III Progress Monitored Regularly; e-Filing 3.0 Implemented Across All District Courts in Punjab

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
25 JUL 2026 9:02PM by PIB Delhi

The eCourts Mission Mode Project Phase-III is being implemented through an institutional framework wherein the e-Committee, Supreme Court of India provides policy inputs and the High Courts are implementing agencies. The implementation of the Project, including in the State of Punjab, is monitored on a regular basis through periodic review meetings, progress reports and continuous coordination with the concerned High Court to facilitate timely implementation of the approved components under the Project.

The status of digital court infrastructure, district-wise are at
Annexure-I.

E-filing 3.0 has been implemented in all the District Courts in the State of Punjab. Adequate digital facilities and infrastructure for virtual hearings have been provided in the District Courts in the State of Punjab as per the guidelines of the eCommittee, Supreme Court of India.

Annexure-I
